title: Cinderella’s Hypnotic Feet
description:
You, the Prince, meet me at the ball. Your eyes are drawn to my sparking shoes, and dainty feet. You find my feet hypnotic, impossible to resist as you lead me, or follow me around the grand ballroom of the palace. Soon your mind is conjuring sexy scenarios of us together, you enjoying the pleasure of foot worship as I use my hypnosis skill to lull you into a rhythmical trance.

You’ll fall into foot worship with this femdom hypno file based on the classic tale of Cinderella, with a little hypnosis and foot worship twist!

Part of the Bedtime Stories Collab with The Hypno Collective.

Art by Rielilu.
